nodes.label: The sizing ladder (tshirt / reference-class / explicit)
nodes.rationale: Three methods in increasing order of evidence; the tool records which was used and prints its caveat verbatim, because the caveat is what stops the number being over-read.

nodes.label: T-shirt sizes calibrated per board
nodes.rationale: An organisation-wide scale is a fiction; S/M/L/XL are quartiles of the board's own completed epics. Fewer than eight completed epics is a refusal since four quartiles from seven observations are noise wearing a uniform. The range reflects variance within a band, not the risk of the wrong band.

nodes.label: What counts as a finished epic
nodes.rationale: Stopped growing (no item created in 30 days), at least 90% complete, at least three items; thresholds are arguments to epic_sizes().

nodes.label: Epic grouping field chosen once for the whole set
nodes.rationale: epicKey where present, else epic; chosen once rather than per issue because 'epicKey or epic' splits a single epic in two and shrinks every band. The calculator payload carries epicKey and cannot carry epic, so until sizing grouped on the key it refused for every board.

nodes.label: Two capacity scenarios, always both
nodes.rationale: Earliest possible (dedicated capacity) and realistic (queued behind committed work, throughput thinned at the measured interruption rate as a stochastic series, not a multiplier). Two dates make the gap the subject.

nodes.label: Cost of the existing queue
nodes.rationale: The number to quote: the price of everything already in flight in working days at the 85th percentile, converting 'why can't you start now' into arithmetic.

nodes.label: Uncertainty attribution (size vs delivery)
nodes.rationale: Three simulations: both varying, size frozen at median, throughput frozen at mean; partial spreads attributed proportionally. Answers which uncertainty to go and reduce; sends a vague ask to refinement and stops a team being told to tighten an estimate that was never the problem.

nodes.label: The readiness gate
nodes.rationale: Required: title, team, sizing. Recommended: problemStatement, successMeasure, neededBy, valueEstimate, dependencies, assumptions, each absence reported with its consequence. Exists because an intake tool's failure mode is making an unchallenged ask look processed.

nodes.label: Sequencing every ordering of the queue
nodes.rationale: Evaluates every ordering: when each ask lands at the 85th percentile and what it costs the others, and names first anything unachievable at any priority, which is the conversation that otherwise happens six weeks late.

nodes.label: At most twelve asks on every transport
nodes.rationale: Cost is cubic: 4 asks ~1 s, 8 ~7 s, 12 ~21 s, 16 ~48 s natively, ten times slower on Forge. intake.MAX_ASKS and intake.too_many_asks() refuse before reading the board; service and Forge quote that sentence. Twelve because three and a half minutes is as long as a reader should watch a tile.

nodes.label: No priority score is computed
nodes.rationale: WSJF and kin multiply an unvalidated value by an unvalidated size and present the product as arithmetic. The delivery consequence of an ordering is computable and returned; the relative worth of asks is a judgement owned by people.

nodes.label: The ask JSON format
nodes.rationale: id, title, requestedBy, team, problemStatement, successMeasure, sizing {method,size,basis}, valueEstimate {amount,basis,confidence}, neededBy, dependencies, assumptions.

nodes.label: What the intake forecast cannot see
nodes.rationale: Dependencies outside the board, the t-shirt judgement itself, work not yet raised, whether the ask is worth doing, ramp-up. Restated in every brief because a forecast that hides its blind spots is worse than none.

nodes.label: Intake reproducibility (SEED 20260816)
nodes.rationale: 20,000 trials per scenario, 8,000 per ordering; percentiles 50/70/85/95; every horizon in working days beside its date.

nodes.label: data/demo-intake-bundle.json
nodes.rationale: The main demo bundle has no finished epics, so make_intake_demo.py writes a separate bundle with 16 delivered epics dated before the demo window so the delivery forecaster's trailing throughput is untouched.

nodes.label: Agent intake mode's four standing rules
nodes.rationale: Run readiness first; report both scenarios; lead with the attribution, not the date; unachievable_at_any_priority is the headline whenever non-empty.
